text:
Elena (Mktg): Heads-up team — launch next Wed. Need a compact creative bundle for assets and ops. Deliverables: 1) benchmark comparison grid for LP + social, 2) two social card sizes (static) with 2 CTA copy variants, 3) webinar hero + single-slide TL;DR visual, 4) email header (light/dark), 5) simple inbound routing diagram showing canary flow, 6) one-page brand compliance checklist for localization. Can we get drafts in 24h? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ravi (Design): OK. Quick q: benchmark grid — do we want columns for Latency/Cost/Quality only or include a small notes column for deployment mode?

Elena (Mktg): Stick to Latency (p50), Cost per 1k tokens, and a 10-word Quality note. No deployment column; we'll annotate deployment in the routing diagram instead. Mobile-first layout is priority.

Sam (Growth): Add two CTA microcopies for A/B test: "Compare latency & cost" and "See the numbers". Keep CTA on lower-right with 16px padding.

Ravi (Design): Noted. Sizes: social 1200x628 and 1080x1080. Webinar hero 1920x1080, TL;DR 1024x576. Email header 600x200. Routing diagram as editable SVG.

Nina (PMM): Use the v2 palette but avoid heavy gradients. Legal: do not use competitor logos or direct model names; use anonymized labels ("Open model A"). Include alt-text for all images and a brief copy deck for localization (strings file).

Ravi (Design): Will provide: Figma page + individual PNG exports + SVG for diagram + a PDF checklist. Bench grid specs in Figma: 3 columns, row height 44px desktop, 36px mobile, dot-sparklines 60x10, font Inter (600 model, 400 copy).

Elena (Mktg): Important: make the benchmark grid scannable on mobile — bold model names, tiny legend, use color for winners only. Also include a progressive disclosure tooltip layer in Figma with raw numbers.

DesignOps Bot: Reminder — upload all final assets to /shared/launch-assets/4912345678/ and tag "launch-bundle-4912". Set permissions: marketing+design view/edit.

Ravi (Design): For the routing diagram, I'll show: Client webhook -> Redwood Hosted API -> Dedicated pool (fallback) -> Email ops/sre. Canary splits: 5%/20%/50% presets annotated. Also highlight where telemetry and cost knobs live.

Sam (Growth): Can we get social card with isolated CTA layer so we can swap copy in the ad platform? Also provide 2 PNGs and the source Figma component.

Nina (PMM): Add speaker headshots as circular overlays (120px) on hero mockups. Provide headshot export guidelines and alt-text templates.

Elena (Mktg): Timeline: drafts in 24h (Figma links), final pack in 48h. Tag me and @Sam on upload. Thanks! :sparkles:

Ravi (Design): Starting now. Will ping once Figma drafts are up. :thumbsup:
